name: SDF-Accelerated Volumetric Cloud Rendering
aliases: Ray marching with Signed Distance Fields
definition: A technique to accelerate real-time volumetric cloud rendering by using a Signed Distance Field (SDF) to skip empty space and determine step sizes, allowing for high sample counts without performance loss.
summary: SDF-Accelerated Volumetric Cloud Rendering is a real-time technique that uses Signed Distance Fields to skip empty space and optimize step sizes, enabling high-quality static cloud rendering without performance loss.
